        tvg_id = self._params.get('tvg_id', '')
        xbmcplugin.setContent(self._handle, 'videos')
        xbmcplugin.setPluginCategory(self._handle, f'{_L(32009)} – {name}')
        now     = time.time()
        days    = max(1, setting_int('epg_hours_back', 72) // 24)
        from_ts = now - days * 86400
        prgs    = []
        mgr = self._epg_mgr(p)
        if mgr:
            prgs = mgr.get_range(tvg_id, from_ts, now)
        if not prgs and tvg_id:
            stb = self._stb(p)
            if stb:
                for e in stb.get_short_epg(tvg_id, count=50):
                    try:
                        s = int(e.get('start_timestamp', e.get('time', 0)))
                        q = int(e.get('stop_timestamp',  e.get('time_to', 0)))
                        if s and q and q < now:
                            from epg import Programme
                            prgs.append(Programme(
                                channel=tvg_id, start=s, stop=q,
                                title=e.get('name', ''), desc=e.get('descr', '')
                            ))
                    except Exception:
                        pass
        if not prgs:
            notify(_L(32009), _L(32047))
            xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle)
            return
        import datetime as _dt
        for pr in sorted(prgs, key=lambda x: x.start, reverse=True):
            dt_s = _dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(pr.start).strftime('%d/%m  %H:%M')
            li   = xbmcgui.ListItem(f'{dt_s}   {pr.title}')
            li.setInfo('video', {
                'title': pr.title, 'plot': pr.desc,
                'duration': max(0, pr.stop - pr.start), 'mediatype': 'video',
            })
            li.setProperty('IsPlayable', 'true')
            xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(
                self._handle,
                self.url(action='play_stb_catchup', pid=p['id'],
                         cmd=cmd, name=pr.title,
                         start=int(pr.start), stop=int(pr.stop)),
                li, False
            )
        xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle)

    def _stb_account(self):
        p = self._portal()
        if not p:
            return
        stb    = self._stb(p)
        info_d = stb.get_account_info() if stb else {}
        lines = [
            f'Portal:  {p["name"]}',
            f'MAC:     {p.get("stb_mac", "")}',
        ]
        _status = info_d.get('status', '')
        if _status:
            lines.append(f'Status:  {_status}')
        _pv2 = info_d.get('phone', '')
        _end = info_d.get('end_date', '')
        if _pv2:
            import re as _re2
            _pv2_norm = _re2.sub(r'\b(am|pm)\b', lambda m: m.group().upper(), _pv2.strip(), flags=_re2.IGNORECASE)
            _matched2 = False
            for _fmt2 in ('%B %d, %Y, %I:%M %p', '%B %d, %Y, %-I:%M %p', '%B %d, %Y',
                          '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', '%Y-%m-%d', '%d.%m.%Y'):
                try:
                    import datetime as _dtp3
                    _exp2 = _dtp3.datetime.strptime(_pv2_norm, _fmt2)
                    _days2 = (_exp2 - _dtp3.datetime.now()).days
                    lines.append(f'Läuft ab: {_exp2.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M")}  ({_days2} Tage)')
                    _matched2 = True
                    break
                except Exception:
                    pass
            if not _matched2:
                lines.append(f'Läuft ab: {_pv2}')
        elif _end:
            try:
                import datetime as _dtp4
                _exp3 = _dtp4.datetime.strptime(_end[:10], '%Y-%m-%d')
                _days3 = (_exp3 - _dtp4.datetime.now()).days
                lines.append(f'Läuft ab: {_exp3.strftime("%d.%m.%Y")}  ({_days3} Tage)')
            except Exception:
                lines.append(f'Läuft ab: {_end}')
        _pkg = info_d.get('tariff_plan_name', '')
        if _pkg:
            lines.append(f'Paket:    {_pkg}')
        _mc = info_d.get('max_connections', '')
        if _mc:
            lines.append(f'Max conn: {_mc}')
        xbmcgui.Dialog().ok(_L(32013), '\n'.join(lines))
        xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle)

    def _search_results(self):
        query = self._params.get('q', '')
        pid   = self._params.get('pid', '')
        if not query:
            xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle)
            return
        xbmcplugin.setContent(self._handle, 'videos')
        xbmcplugin.setPluginCategory(self._handle, f'{_L(32005)}: {query}')
        import portals as P
        from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
        search_list = [P.get_by_id(pid)] if pid else P.get_active()
        search_list = [x for x in search_list if x]

        all_items = []
        workers   = min(len(search_list), 6)
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as pool:
            futures = {pool.submit(self._search_in_portal_collect, p, query): p
                       for p in search_list}
            for fut in as_completed(futures):
                try:
                    all_items.extend(fut.result())
                except Exception as e:
                    error(f'search thread error: {e}')

        all_items = apply_lang_sort(
            all_items,
            name_fn=lambda x: x[1].getLabel(),
            group_fn=lambda x: ''
        )
        for url, li, is_folder in all_items:
            xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(self._handle, url, li, is_folder)

        if not all_items:
            notify(_L(32005), _L(32046, query))
        xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle)

    def _search_in_portal(self, p: dict, query: str) -> int:
        items = self._search_in_portal_collect(p, query)
        for url, li, is_folder in items:
            xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(self._handle, url, li, is_folder)
        return len(items)

    def _search_in_portal_collect(self, p: dict, query: str) -> list:
        ptype  = p.get('type', 'm3u')
        items  = []

        if ptype == 'stb':
            stb = self._stb(p)
            if stb:
                from iptv import Channel
                from player import channel_list_item
                for s in stb.search_live(query)[:50]:
                    ch = Channel(name=s.get('name', ''), url=s.get('cmd', ''),
                                 logo=s.get('logo', ''), group='Live')
                    items.append((
                        self.url(action='play_stb_live', pid=p['id'],
                                 cmd=s.get('cmd', ''), name=ch.name, logo=ch.logo),
                        channel_list_item(ch), False))
                for v in stb.search_vod(query)[:50]:
                    li = xbmcgui.ListItem(v.get('name', ''))
                    li.setInfo('video', {'title': v.get('name', ''), 'mediatype': 'movie'})
                    li.setProperty('IsPlayable', 'true')
                    items.append((
                        self.url(action='play_stb_vod', pid=p['id'],
                                 cmd=v.get('cmd', ''), name=v.get('name', '')),
                        li, False))

        elif ptype == 'xtream':
            xc = self._xc(p)
            if xc:
                from iptv import Channel
                from player import channel_list_item, vod_list_item
                for s in xc.search_live(query)[:50]:
                    ch = Channel(name=s.get('name', ''),
                                 url=xc.live_stream_url(s['stream_id']),
                                 logo=s.get('stream_icon', ''), group='Live')
                    items.append((
                        self.url(action='play_live', url=ch.url,
                                 name=ch.name, logo=ch.logo),
                        channel_list_item(ch), False))
                for v in xc.search_vod(query)[:50]:
                    li = vod_list_item(v)
                    items.append((
                        self.url(action='play_vod', pid=p['id'],
                                 stream_id=v.get('stream_id'),
                                 ext=v.get('container_extension', 'mkv'),
                                 title=v.get('name'), logo=v.get('stream_icon', '')),
                        li, False))
                for s in xc.search_series(query)[:50]:
                    li = xbmcgui.ListItem(s.get('name', ''))
                    li.setArt({'thumb': s.get('cover', ''), 'icon': s.get('cover', '')})
                    li.setInfo('video', {'title': s.get('name', ''),
                                         'mediatype': 'tvshow', 'plot': s.get('plot', '')})
                    items.append((
                        self.url(action='series_seasons', pid=p['id'],
                                 series_id=s.get('series_id')),
                        li, True))

        else:
            from iptv import load_m3u, split_m3u_sections
            all_ch   = load_m3u(p.get('m3u_url', ''), portal_id=p['id'])
            sections = split_m3u_sections(all_ch)
            q = query.lower()
            for section, mediatype in (
                ('live',   'video'),
                ('movies', 'movie'),
                ('series', 'episode'),
            ):
                for ch in sections.get(section, []):
                    if q in ch.name.lower() or q in (ch.group or '').lower():
                        li = xbmcgui.ListItem(ch.name)
                        li.setArt({'thumb': ch.logo, 'icon': ch.logo})
                        li.setInfo('video', {'title': ch.name, 'mediatype': mediatype})
                        li.setProperty('IsPlayable', 'true')
                        items.append((
                            self.url(action='play_live', url=ch.url,
                                     name=ch.name, logo=ch.logo),
                            li, False))
                        if len(items) >= 200:
                            return apply_lang_sort(items, name_fn=lambda x: x[1].getLabel(), group_fn=lambda x: '')
        return apply_lang_sort(items, name_fn=lambda x: x[1].getLabel(), group_fn=lambda x: '')

    def _epg_channel(self):
        p = self._portal()
        if not p:
            return
        tvg_id = self._params.get('tvg_id', '')
        name   = self._params.get('name', tvg_id)
        sid = self._params.get('sid','')
        if sid:

    def _load_channels(self, p: dict, force: bool = False):
        ptype = p.get('type', 'm3u')
        if ptype == 'stb':
            from stalker import client_for_portal
            from iptv import Channel
            stb = client_for_portal(p)
            if not stb or not stb.authenticate():
                return []
            cats = {str(c['id']): c.get('title', '')
                    for c in stb.get_live_categories(force=force)}
            return [
                Channel(
                    name    = s.get('name', ''),
                    url     = s.get('cmd', ''),
                    logo    = s.get('logo', ''),
                    group   = cats.get(str(s.get('genre_id',
                                               s.get('tv_genre_id', ''))),
                                       'Uncategorised'),
                    tvg_id  = s.get('epg_channel_id') or str(s.get('id', '')),
                    tvg_name= s.get('name', ''),
                )
                for s in stb.get_live_channels(force=force)
            ]
        elif ptype == 'xtream':
            from xtream import XtreamClient
            from iptv import Channel
            xc   = XtreamClient(p['xc_host'], p['xc_user'], p['xc_pass'])
            # Never block back navigation with server requests. Kodi service
            # preloads these two indexes independently of the interface.
            cats_raw = (xc.get_live_categories(force_refresh=True) if force else
                        xc.get_cached_catalog('get_live_categories'))
            channels_raw = (xc.get_live_streams(force_refresh=True) if force else
                            xc.get_cached_catalog('get_live_streams'))
            if cats_raw is None or channels_raw is None:
                return []
            cats = {str(c['category_id']): c.get('category_name', '')
                    for c in cats_raw if isinstance(c, dict) and 'category_id' in c}
            return [
                Channel(
                    name    = s.get('name', ''),
                    url     = xc.live_stream_url(s.get('stream_id', ''), 'ts'),
                    logo    = s.get('stream_icon', ''),
                    group   = cats.get(str(s.get('category_id', '')), 'Uncategorised'),
                    extra   = {'category_id': str(s.get('category_id', '')),
                               'stream_id': str(s.get('stream_id', ''))},
                    tvg_id  = s.get('epg_channel_id', ''),
                    tvg_name= s.get('name', ''),
                )
                for s in channels_raw if isinstance(s, dict)
            ]
        else:
            from iptv import load_m3u
            url = p.get('m3u_url', '').strip()
            if not url:
                error(f'load_channels: portal "{p.get("name")}" has no m3u_url')
                return []
            return load_m3u(url,
                            portal_id=p.get('id', ''),
                            force_refresh=force)

    finally:db.close()
    if not allowed:
        update(pid,'refresh','BACKUP_REQUIRED',running=False)
        return {}
    streams=list(active_streams(portal));config=configuration(pid)
    if not streams:
        update(pid,'cache','WAIT_ACTIVE_CATALOG',running=False)
        from catalog_sync import request
        request(portal,'live',portal.get('start_group_id',''),priority=0)
        return {}
    if not portal.get('epg_show',True): return {}
    from epg_report53 import started as source_started53,source_done as source_done53
    selected53=portal.get('_epg_sources53')
    provider_failure52=0;uri=''
    if portal.get('provider_epg_enabled',True) and (selected53 is None or 'provider' in selected53):
        try:uri=portal.get('epg_url') or for_portal(portal).get_xmltv_epg_url() or ''
        except Exception as exc:
            code,fields=failure_details(exc,'DOWNLOAD')
            update(pid,'provider',code,running=False,**fields);provider_failure52=1
            source_started53(pid,'provider','provider',0);source_done53(pid,'provider',code)
    provider=dict(uri=uri,local=not uri.startswith(('http://','https://')))
    sources=([('provider',provider,0)] if uri and portal.get('provider_epg_enabled',True) else [])+[(source_key(s),s,i) for i,s in enumerate(config['sources'],1) if s.get('enabled',True)]
    if selected53 is not None:
        from guide_publish44 import source_id
        sources=[s for s in sources if source_id(s[1],s[2]) in selected53]
    successes=0;failures=provider_failure52;stages=[]
    for key,source,index in sources:
        if cancel(): break
        identity53=__import__('guide_publish44').source_id(source,index)
        source_started53(pid,key,identity53,index)
        update(pid,key,'RUNNING',running=True,source_index=index)
        try:
            stage=import_source(pid,source,index,streams,config['mappings'],cancel=cancel,stage_only=True)
            stage['key']=key;stages.append(stage)
            update(pid,key,'VERIFIED',running=True,source_index=index)
        except Exception as exc:
            code,fields=failure_details(exc,getattr(exc,'xcmate_stage','MERGE'))
            update(pid,key,code,running=False,source_index=index,**fields);failures+=1
            source_done53(pid,identity53,code)
    if cancel():
        discard_stages44(stages)
        for stage in stages:update(pid,stage['key'],'CANCELLED',running=False)
        update(pid,'refresh','CANCELLED',running=False)
        return {}
    try:
        outcomes=publish_stages44(pid,stages,cancel=cancel) if stages else []
    except Exception as exc:
        discard_stages44(stages)
        code,fields=failure_details(exc,'MERGE')
        for stage in stages:update(pid,stage['key'],code,running=False,**fields)
        update(pid,'refresh',code,running=False,**fields)
        return {}
    for stage,outcome in zip(stages,outcomes):
        counts=stage['counts'];successes+=1
        source_done53(pid,__import__('guide_publish44').source_id(stage['source'],stage['index']),'PARTIAL_PRESERVED' if outcome['code']=='PARTIAL_PRESERVED' else 'READY',counts,outcome)
        update(pid,stage['key'],'PARTIAL_PRESERVED' if outcome['code']=='PARTIAL_PRESERVED' else 'READY',running=False,
            source_index=stage['index'],channels=counts['channels'],programmes=counts['stored'],bytes=counts['bytes'])
    result=fast_snapshot(pid,streams,config['mappings'])
    if successes and result:
        _save_disk(pid,result);_mem_set(pid,result)
        from epg_sources import _channels_cache_key
        from utils import cache_set
        # Mapping chooser receives the relevant canonical IDs after a large
        # import too; user configuration itself is never overwritten.
        cache_set(_channels_cache_key(pid),{str(e.get('channel')):r.get('name','')
            for r in streams for e in result.get(r['sid'],[])[:1]})
        update(pid,'refresh','READY' if not failures else 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS',running=False,loaded=successes,failed=failures)
        return result
    update(pid,'refresh','READY_NO_NOW' if successes else 'NO_NEW_GUIDE',running=False,loaded=successes,failed=failures)
    return {}

msgctxt "#36306"
msgid "1. Open the desired home row in BINGIE widget configuration. Keep existing working rows. 2. Choose Use as widget for the opened source and confirm the BINGIE configuration. BINGIE saves the binding; browsing XCMate alone does not save it."
msgstr "1. In der BINGIE-Widget-Konfiguration die gewünschte Startseitenreihe öffnen. Bestehende funktionierende Reihen beibehalten. 2. Für den geöffneten Quellordner Als Widget verwenden wählen und die BINGIE-Konfiguration bestätigen. BINGIE speichert die Verknüpfung; das Durchstöbern von XCMate allein speichert sie noch nicht."

msgctxt "#36411"
msgid "Choose the BINGIE Home destination"
msgstr "BINGIE-Home-Ziel auswählen"

msgctxt "#36412"
msgid "{0} → Home position {1}. A private original backup and rollback roundtrip have been verified. Only this selected slot is changed. Before SHA256: {2} After SHA256: {3}. Save this binding now?"

msgctxt "#36413"
msgid "Explicit approval for this reviewed change"
msgstr "Ausdrückliche Freigabe dieser geprüften Änderung"

msgctxt "#36414"
msgid "Yes, save this binding"
msgstr "Ja, diese Verknüpfung speichern"

msgctxt "#36415"
msgid "Saved and verified; native BINGIE rebuild requested. Home display still needs device acceptance."
msgstr "Gespeichert und verifiziert; nativer BINGIE-Neuaufbau angefordert. Home-Anzeige muss noch am Gerät geprüft werden."

msgctxt "#36416"
msgid "The verified Live Home patch is already active. Choose Live TV in Widgets to link a Home position."
msgstr "Der verifizierte Live-Home-Patch ist bereits aktiv. Unter Widgets Live-TV wählen und eine Home-Position verknüpfen."

msgctxt "#36417"
msgid "Review only: four known BINGIE 2.2.3 files receive the Home Hero/station strip and native widget candidates. Movie/series rendering, bindings and settings remain unchanged. msgstr "Nur Vorschau: Vier bekannte BINGIE-2.2.3-Dateien erhalten Home-Hero/Senderleiste und native Widgetkandidaten. Film-/Seriendarstellung, Verknüpfungen und Einstellungen bleiben erhalten. msgid "Apply only these four reviewed skin changes now? Verified backups remain available for rollback. The native BINGIE builder will rebuild Home; no reset or profile cleanup is performed. Cancel keeps the current skin intact."

msgctxt "#36424"
msgid "Yes, restore this original"
msgstr "Ja, dieses Original wiederherstellen"

msgctxt "#36425"
msgid "Original restored and verified; native BINGIE rebuild requested."

msgctxt "#36426"
msgid "Cancel"
msgstr "Abbrechen"

msgctxt "#36428"
msgid "This Home profile cannot safely be edited directly (not yet saved, renamed Home or single-widget mode). Open the native BINGIE editor? Choose the desired Home widget position there. After the separately approved Home patch, the direct XCMate candidates appear in its widget selector. No reset is needed."
msgstr "Dieses Home-Profil lässt sich nicht sicher direkt bearbeiten (noch nicht gespeichert, Home umbenannt oder Einzelwidget-Modus). Den nativen BINGIE-Editor öffnen? Dort die gewünschte Home-Position wählen. Nach dem separat freigegebenen Home-Patch stehen die direkten XCMate-Kandidaten in seiner Widgetauswahl bereit. Kein Reset erforderlich."

msgctxt "#36429"
msgid "Open native BINGIE setup"
msgstr "Native BINGIE-Einrichtung öffnen"

msgctxt "#36500"
msgid "Use the configured credentials? Values from XCMate → Configure will be used for a new setup without displaying them here. Existing portals are preserved. Missing values can be completed."

msgctxt "#36501"
msgid "A previous setup job is still closing. Please wait briefly and reopen the wizard."
msgstr "Ein vorheriger Einrichtungsauftrag wird noch beendet. Bitte kurz warten und den Assistenten erneut öffnen."

msgctxt "#36502"
msgid "Setup timed out. Cancellation has been requested. Existing portals are preserved. Check your connection and reopen; a running job will not be started twice."
msgstr "Zeitüberschreitung bei der Einrichtung. Der Auftrag wurde zum Abbruch aufgefordert. Bereits gespeicherte Portale bleiben erhalten. Bitte Verbindung prüfen und erneut öffnen; ein noch laufender Auftrag wird nicht doppelt gestartet."

msgctxt "#36503"
msgid "Displaying groups: {0} / {1}"

msgctxt "#36504"
msgid "Updating selection markers …"

msgctxt "#36505"
msgid "Saving setup: transferring data in verified batches …"
msgstr "Einrichtung speichern: Daten werden in geprüften Blöcken übertragen …"

msgctxt "#36506"
msgid "Saving setup: verifying saved data and index …"
msgstr "Einrichtung speichern: gespeicherte Daten und Index prüfen …"

msgctxt "#36510"
msgid "XCMate {0} is installed.\n\n• EPG manager: source comparison and live preview in the guide.\n• Automatic EPG updates every 24 hours by default, with readable reports.\n• Wizard: keep inputs and selected groups when errors occur.\n• Password remains available during Back and Retry in the current setup.\n\nAfter restarting Kodi, an unsaved password must be entered again. Existing portals and widgets are preserved."
msgstr "XCMate {0} ist installiert.\n\n• EPG-Manager: Quellenvergleich und Live-Vorschau im Raster.\n• EPG automatisch alle 24 Stunden als Standard, mit lesbaren Berichten.\n• Wizard: Eingaben und gewählte Gruppen bleiben bei Fehlern erhalten.\n• Das Passwort bleibt bei Zurück und Wiederholen in der laufenden Einrichtung erhalten.\n\nNach einem Kodi-Neustart muss ein nicht gespeichertes Passwort erneut eingegeben werden. Bestehende Portale und Widgets bleiben erhalten."

msgid "Choose a widget, select a free BINGIE Home position, review the backup and explicitly save. Existing rows are kept."

msgctxt "#36414"
msgid "Yes, save this binding"

msgctxt "#36415"
msgid "Saved and verified; native BINGIE rebuild requested. Home display still needs device acceptance."

msgctxt "#36416"
msgid "The verified Live Home patch is already active. Choose Live TV in Widgets to link a Home position."

msgctxt "#36417"
msgid "Review only: four known BINGIE 2.2.3 files receive the Home Hero/station strip and native widget candidates. Movie/series rendering, bindings and settings remain unchanged. Exact originals, candidates and rollback tests are saved privately. File checksums follow. Nothing has been applied yet."

msgctxt "#36418"
msgid "Apply only these four reviewed skin changes now? Verified backups remain available for rollback. The native BINGIE builder will rebuild Home; no reset or profile cleanup is performed. Cancel keeps the current skin intact."

msgctxt "#36424"

msgctxt "#36425"
msgid "Original restored and verified; native BINGIE rebuild requested."

msgid "Cancel"
msgstr "Abbrechen"

msgctxt "#36428"
msgid "This Home profile cannot safely be edited directly (not yet saved, renamed Home or single-widget mode). Open the native BINGIE editor? Choose the desired Home widget position there. msgstr "Dieses Home-Profil lässt sich nicht sicher direkt bearbeiten (noch nicht gespeichert, Home umbenannt oder Einzelwidget-Modus). Den nativen BINGIE-Editor öffnen? Dort die gewünschte Home-Position wählen. Nach dem separat freigegebenen Home-Patch stehen die direkten XCMate-Kandidaten in seiner Widgetauswahl bereit. Kein Reset erforderlich."

msgctxt "#36429"
msgid "Open native BINGIE setup"
msgstr "Native BINGIE-Einrichtung öffnen"

msgctxt "#36500"
msgid "Use the configured credentials? Values from XCMate → Configure will be used for a new setup without displaying them here. Existing portals are preserved. Missing values can be completed."

msgctxt "#36501"
msgid "A previous setup job is still closing. Please wait briefly and reopen the wizard."
msgstr "Ein vorheriger Einrichtungsauftrag wird noch beendet. Bitte kurz warten und den Assistenten erneut öffnen."

msgctxt "#36502"
msgid "Setup timed out. Cancellation has been requested. Existing portals are preserved. Check your connection and reopen; a running job will not be started twice."
msgstr "Zeitüberschreitung bei der Einrichtung. Der Auftrag wurde zum Abbruch aufgefordert. Bereits gespeicherte Portale bleiben erhalten. Bitte Verbindung prüfen und erneut öffnen; ein noch laufender Auftrag wird nicht doppelt gestartet."

msgctxt "#36503"
msgid "Displaying groups: {0} / {1}"
msgstr "Gruppen anzeigen: {0} / {1}"

msgctxt "#36504"
msgid "Updating selection markers …"
msgstr "Auswahlmarkierungen werden aktualisiert …"

msgctxt "#36505"
msgid "Saving setup: transferring data in verified batches …"
msgstr "Einrichtung speichern: Daten werden in geprüften Blöcken übertragen …"

msgctxt "#36506"
msgid "Saving setup: verifying saved data and index …"
msgstr "Einrichtung speichern: gespeicherte Daten und Index prüfen …"

msgctxt "#36510"
msgid "XCMate {0} is installed.\n\n• EPG manager: source comparison and live preview in the guide.\n• Automatic EPG updates every 24 hours by default, with readable reports.\n• Wizard: keep inputs and selected groups when errors occur.\n• Password remains available during Back and Retry in the current setup.\n\nAfter restarting Kodi, an unsaved password must be entered again. Existing portals and widgets are preserved."
msgstr "XCMate {0} ist installiert.\n\n• EPG-Manager: Quellenvergleich und Live-Vorschau im Raster.\n• EPG automatisch alle 24 Stunden als Standard, mit lesbaren Berichten.\n• Wizard: Eingaben und gewählte Gruppen bleiben bei Fehlern erhalten.\n• Das Passwort bleibt bei Zurück und Wiederholen in der laufenden Einrichtung erhalten.\n\nNach einem Kodi-Neustart muss ein nicht gespeichertes Passwort erneut eingegeben werden. Bestehende Portale und Widgets bleiben erhalten."

msgctxt "#36520"
msgid "Installation successful"
msgstr "Installation erfolgreich"

msgctxt "#36521"
msgid "Version {0}\n\nChanges:\n• Connection checked separately, with a clear success message.\n• Completed catalogue groups survive retries.\n• Portal saved before optional EPG imports.\n• EPG sources resume separately, with real progress and no total runtime limit.\n• New passwords remain editable during the running setup.\n• Clearer group counts and the regular XCMate background.\n\nAfter a new Kodi/Python session, an unsaved password must be entered again. Existing portals and settings are preserved."
msgstr "Version {0}\n\nÄnderungen:\n• Verbindung getrennt prüfen und Erfolg klar bestätigen.\n• Abgeschlossene Kataloggruppen bei Wiederholung erhalten.\n• Portal vor dem optionalen EPG-Import speichern.\n• EPG-Quellen einzeln fortsetzen, mit echtem Fortschritt und ohne Gesamtlaufzeitgrenze.\n• Neue Passwörter bleiben in der laufenden Einrichtung bearbeitbar.\n• Lesbare Gruppenzahlen und regulärer XCMate-Hintergrund.\n\nNach einer neuen Kodi-/Python-Sitzung muss ein ungespeichertes Passwort erneut eingegeben werden. Bestehende Portale und Einstellungen bleiben erhalten."

msgstr "Apply only these four reviewed skin changes now? Verified backups remain available for rollback. The native BINGIE builder will rebuild Home; no reset or profile cleanup is performed. Cancel keeps the current skin intact."

msgctxt "#36419"
msgid "Yes, approve these four skin files"
msgstr "Yes, approve these four skin files"

msgctxt "#36420"
msgid "Widget binding backup"
msgstr "Widget binding backup"

msgctxt "#36421"
msgid "Home skin backup"
msgstr "Home skin backup"

msgctxt "#36422"
msgid "No applied or interrupted .50 change is available to restore."
msgstr "No applied or interrupted .50 change is available to restore."

msgctxt "#36423"
msgid "Restore the verified original only if all target files still match this plan? Later external changes are never overwritten."
msgstr "Restore the verified original only if all target files still match this plan? Later external changes are never overwritten."

msgctxt "#36424"
msgid "Yes, restore this original"
msgstr "Yes, restore this original"

msgctxt "#36425"
msgid "Original restored and verified; native BINGIE rebuild requested."
msgstr "Original restored and verified; native BINGIE rebuild requested."

msgctxt "#36426"
msgid "Cancel"
msgstr "Cancel"

msgctxt "#36427"
msgid "Save the reviewed {0} binding to Home position {1} now? The verified original remains available for rollback."
msgstr "Save the reviewed {0} binding to Home position {1} now? The verified original remains available for rollback."

msgctxt "#36428"
msgid "This Home profile cannot safely be edited directly (not yet saved, renamed Home or single-widget mode). Open the native BINGIE editor? Choose the desired Home widget position there. After the separately approved Home patch, the direct XCMate candidates appear in its widget selector. No reset is needed."
msgstr "This Home profile cannot safely be edited directly (not yet saved, renamed Home or single-widget mode). Open the native BINGIE editor? Choose the desired Home widget position there. After the separately approved Home patch, the direct XCMate candidates appear in its widget selector. No reset is needed."

msgctxt "#36429"
msgid "Open native BINGIE setup"
msgstr "Open native BINGIE setup"

msgctxt "#36500"
msgid "Use the configured credentials? Values from XCMate → Configure will be used for a new setup without displaying them here. Existing portals are preserved. Missing values can be completed."
msgstr "Use the configured credentials? Values from XCMate → Configure will be used for a new setup without displaying them here. Existing portals are preserved. Missing values can be completed."

msgctxt "#36501"
msgid "A previous setup job is still closing. Please wait briefly and reopen the wizard."
msgstr "A previous setup job is still closing. Please wait briefly and reopen the wizard."

msgctxt "#36502"
msgid "Setup timed out. Cancellation has been requested. Existing portals are preserved. Check your connection and reopen; a running job will not be started twice."
msgstr "Setup timed out. Cancellation has been requested. Existing portals are preserved. Check your connection and reopen; a running job will not be started twice."

msgctxt "#36503"
msgid "Displaying groups: {0} / {1}"
msgstr "Displaying groups: {0} / {1}"

msgctxt "#36504"
msgid "Updating selection markers …"
msgstr "Updating selection markers …"

msgctxt "#36505"
msgid "Saving setup: transferring data in verified batches …"
msgstr "Saving setup: transferring data in verified batches …"

msgctxt "#36506"
msgid "Saving setup: verifying saved data and index …"
msgstr "Saving setup: verifying saved data and index …"

msgctxt "#36510"
msgid "XCMate {0} is installed.\n\n• EPG manager: source comparison and live preview in the guide.\n• Automatic EPG updates every 24 hours by default, with readable reports.\n• Wizard: keep inputs and selected groups when errors occur.\n• Password remains available during Back and Retry in the current setup.\n\nAfter restarting Kodi, an unsaved password must be entered again. Existing portals and widgets are preserved."
msgstr "XCMate {0} is installed.\n\n• EPG manager: source comparison and live preview in the guide.\n• Automatic EPG updates every 24 hours by default, with readable reports.\n• Wizard: keep inputs and selected groups when errors occur.\n• Password remains available during Back and Retry in the current setup.\n\nAfter restarting Kodi, an unsaved password must be entered again. Existing portals and widgets are preserved."

msgctxt "#36520"
msgid "Installation successful"
msgstr "Installation successful"

msgctxt "#36521"
msgid "Version {0}\n\nChanges:\n• Connection checked separately, with a clear success message.\n• Completed catalogue groups survive retries.\n• Portal saved before optional EPG imports.\n• EPG sources resume separately, with real progress and no total runtime limit.\n• New passwords remain editable during the running setup.\n• Clearer group counts and the regular XCMate background.\n\nAfter a new Kodi/Python session, an unsaved password must be entered again. Existing portals and settings are preserved."
msgstr "Version {0}\n\nChanges:\n• Connection checked separately, with a clear success message.\n• Completed catalogue groups survive retries.\n• Portal saved before optional EPG imports.\n• EPG sources resume separately, with real progress and no total runtime limit.\n• New passwords remain editable during the running setup.\n• Clearer group counts and the regular XCMate background.\n\nAfter a new Kodi/Python session, an unsaved password must be entered again. Existing portals and settings are preserved."
